Package com.privatechain.spring

Class BlockchainProperties

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.spring.BlockchainProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="blockchain") public class BlockchainProperties extends Object
Configuration properties for the private-blockchain Spring Boot autoconfiguration.

All properties are bound to the blockchain.* prefix in application.yml / application.properties. Every field has a production-ready default so that zero configuration is required to start a working in-memory PoW chain (FR-CFG-02, AC-10).

Minimal YAML


 blockchain:
   enabled: true   # default; omit to keep the node active

Full YAML reference


 blockchain:
   enabled: true
   chain-id: my-chain
   network-port: 8545
   block-time-seconds: 10
   difficulty: 4
   max-peers: 25
   mempool:
     ttl: 30m         # Duration — supports 30m, PT30M, 1800s, etc.
     max-size: 10000

IDE autocomplete for all properties is generated at compile time by the spring-boot-configuration-processor annotation processor, which produces META-INF/spring-configuration-metadata.json (T-071).

Since:
1.0.0
